lede: Ohio State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +11.6 against +2.6, a 9.0-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Ohio State -20.6 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Ohio State winning 91% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 88% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
